title: Andrée's Arctic balloon expedition
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Andrée's Arctic balloon expedition", at revision 1383083309, opens: "Andrée's Arctic balloon expedition of 1897 was a failed Swedish attempt to reach the North Pole, resulting in the deaths of all three expedition members, S. A. Andrée, Knut Frænkel, and Nils Strindberg. Andrée proposed a voyage by hydrogen balloon from Svalbard to either Russia or Canada, which was to pass, with luck, straight over the North Pole on the way. The scheme was received with patriotic enthusiasm in Sweden, a northern nation that had fallen behind in the race for the North Pole." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q261538, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "S. A. Andrée's Arctic Balloon Expedition of 1897". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
